title: NSGo game localization string table (version 1)
description:
StringTable is a versioned YAML localization string table for one locale. A file looks like this:

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://game.nsgo.dev/schemas/l10n.v1.json version: 1 locale: en strings: hud.score: "Score: {score}" menu.play: Play plurals: coins: zero: No coins one: "{count} coin" other: "{count} coins"

ParseYAML decodes it strictly and EncodeYAML writes it back in canonical form with sorted keys, so a table EncodeYAML wrote survives a load and save byte for byte.

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must equal StringTableVersion (1).

locale.description: Locale is the normalized BCP-47 locale tag this table translates (for example "en" or "zh-Hans").

strings.description: Strings maps message keys (such as "menu.play" or "hud.score") to localized string templates.

plurals.description: Plurals maps message keys to CLDR plural form templates (zero, one, two, few, many, other).

PluralForms.description: PluralForms holds localized message templates keyed by CLDR cardinal plural category. Any unset category falls back to Other (or One if Other is empty). When count is 0 and Zero is non-empty, Plural always selects Zero regardless of locale.

zero.description: Zero is the template used when count is 0 (if non-empty, for any locale) or matches the CLDR zero category.

one.description: One is the template used for the CLDR one plural category.

two.description: Two is the template used for the CLDR two plural category.

few.description: Few is the template used for the CLDR few plural category.

many.description: Many is the template used for the CLDR many plural category.

other.description: Other is the default fallback template for pluralization.
